description: This file defines the EmpEmergencyContactAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee emergency contacts within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes operations to list, create, retrieve, update, and delete emergency contact records for employees, along with validation rules and documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for managing employee emergency contacts, including listing, adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting contacts with appropriate validation and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of emergency contacts for a specific employee, applying search filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new emergency contact record for an employee.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific emergency contact by its sequence number for an employee.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing emergency contact record for an employee.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple emergency contacts for a specified employee.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Helper method to create or update an emergency contact record based on request parameters.
